project_type: Full-stack monorepo: FastAPI (Python 3.11) backend + Next.js 14 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) frontend. Hospitality guest-intelligence demo platform 'PahadPulse' for Mussoorie/Uttarakhand.
build_system: backend: uv (uv sync, uv run); frontend: npm (Next.js). Root Makefile wraps both (setup/lint/test/build/demo). scripts/demo.sh seeds then launches both servers.
test_framework: backend: pytest (236 tests, uv run pytest, lives under backend/tests presumably, plus hypothesis). frontend: Vitest (npx vitest run, 14 tests) + ESLint. Playwright not used.
build_command: backend: `cd backend && uv run python -c 'import app.main'` ; frontend: `cd frontend && npm run build` (21 routes). Root: `make build`.
test_command: backend: `cd backend && uv run pytest` ; frontend: `cd frontend && npx vitest run`. Lint: `cd backend && uv run ruff check .` and `cd frontend && npm run lint`. Root: `make test` + `make lint`.
verification_instructions: Live dev servers are BLOCKED by a sandbox dev-server guard. Verify run paths IN-PROCESS: use `fastapi.testclient.TestClient(app)` inside `uv run python - <<'PY' ... PY` to hit endpoints (/health, /market-radar/review-counts, /sentinel/board, /destination/heatmap, /concierge/facts, and the new /auth/login). Also run full `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run`, `npm run build`. Run `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` (idempotent) before hitting endpoints.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Checked-in generated artifacts under data/ regenerated from backend scripts: `cd backend && uv run python scripts/build_dataset.py` (regenerates data/sample_reviews/mussoorie_reviews.json + refreshes datasheet.md counts), `uv run python scripts/gen_schema.py` (Review_Record JSON schema), `uv run python scripts/build_hinglish_test_set.py`. Frontend has baked-in *Snapshot.json fixtures under frontend/lib/ used as offline fallback by dashboard pages.
setup_instructions: `make setup` = `cd backend && uv sync` + `cd frontend && npm install`. Deps already synced in this sandbox (Node v22, Python 3.11.15 with uv).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. BUT: (1) sandbox dev-server guard blocks launching live uvicorn/next dev listeners - verify in-process via TestClient and build/test commands only. (2) NO third-party platform API keys and the user wants everything FREE - so NO real live scraping of Google/MakeMyTrip/Booking/TripAdvisor/Agoda (violates their terms, spec Req 2 gates it behind robots.txt+terms). Deliver a GENERATED representative dataset run through the REAL ingestion pipeline instead. (3) Do NOT provision any AWS/paid cloud resources - deployment stays free/local/Codespaces only, documentation only.
contribution_requirements: Keep all four quality gates GREEN: frontend npm run lint + npx vitest run (14) + npm run build (21 routes), backend uv run ruff check . + uv run pytest (236). Add tests for all new backend (data generator, Forest Season Resort seeding, auth/login, upload-ingestion wiring) and new frontend (login page, live-data wiring). Do NOT push or open PRs - the orchestrator publishes. Work on branch main in /projects/sandbox/PahaadPluse. Commit locally.
key_patterns: HOME_PROPERTY_ID is a single hardcoded constant 'mus-pineview' in backend/app/services/market_radar/analytics_dataset.py, imported by changepoints/what_if/playbook/impact/briefing/intervention_store/guest_compass/analytics_service - changing it re-centers all Deep analytics on a new property. Sentinel has its OWN HOME_PROPERTY_ID/HOME_PROPERTY_NAME constants in backend/app/seed/sentinel_seed.py. Concierge hardcodes 'mus-pineview' in service.py (lines ~155,185). The sample review dataset is generated from code in backend/app/seed/sample_reviews.py (PROPERTIES list + _SEED list of RawSeedReview; CLUSTER_NAME='Mussoorie Mall Road Cluster'; per-platform URL patterns). Services are @lru_cache singletons that self-seed; warm.py/seed_all() eagerly warms them on startup (FastAPI lifespan) and via `python -m app.seed`. Dashboard pages (frontend/app/(dashboard)/*/page.tsx) import a *Snapshot.json fixture as initial state then overwrite with live api.* calls in useEffect, falling back silently to the snapshot on fetch error (see market-radar/page.tsx 'live' badge pattern). frontend/lib/api.ts is the typed fetch client; API_BASE_URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000). Auth is currently a STUB (backend/app/core/security.py has only pseudonymize + constant_time_equals; NO User model, NO login endpoint, NO frontend login page). Platforms enum (Google/MakeMyTrip/Booking.com/TripAdvisor/Agoda) in app/models/review.py; Booking/Agoda use native /10 scale, others /5. normalise_rating maps native->1..5.
directory_structure: backend/app/{core,models,schemas,adapters,services,api/routers,seed}; backend/scripts/ (dataset generators); backend/tests/ (pytest); frontend/app/(dashboard)/ (16 dashboard pages + tests), frontend/components/{ui,layout,charts,market-radar,destination,common}, frontend/lib/ (api.ts, theme.ts, *Snapshot.json); data/ (checked-in generated datasets + datasheet.md); scripts/demo.sh; root Makefile.
